name: Berrien County, MI
findings: Berrien County has 527 nonprofit organizations. 215 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 165 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Berrien County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 14 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 31 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
